verdict.rationale: Floot documents an official remote MCP server that connects to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. It runs over MCP on the user's existing AI subscription and exposes a documented toolset (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, create_checkpoint, generate_image), and a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably through the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers
It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), not Floot credits.
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
